name: 3-D Man (Chandler)
deck: 3-D Man is a classic Marvel superhero and member of the Avengers. When wearing his 3-D glasses and concentrating, he had the ability to triple his strength, speed, and stamina. Although his character is essentially a 50's hero, he was created in the 1970's for the comic series, Marvel Premiere.

name: 3-D Man (Garrett, Jr.)
deck: Delroy has three times the physical abilities of someone at the peak of human conditioning as he has been bonded with the spirit of 3-D man.

name: Aarkus
deck: Aarkus was once the Golden Age villain-turned-hero called The Vision, whose people came to our reality to serve as midwives to beings born from Cosmic Cubes.

name: Abe Jenkins
deck: Growing tired of his mechanic job, Abe Jenkins created a suit of armor and became the Beetle. Originally a criminal, he changed his ways as a member of the Thunderbolts, Taking the name MACH-1. Abe became a mainstay of the group and achieved legitimacy as a superhero. As he's upgraded his armor, he's changed his name to reflect the version of his armor.

name: Abraham Erskine
deck: The creator of the Super Soldier Serum that created Captain America. He was assassinated before writing down the formula, which led to several parties attempting to recreate the formula from scratch with little success.

name: Absorbing Man
deck: An extremely violent boxer turned criminal, Loki bestowed his powers upon him, and he was transformed into the Absorbing Man, granting him powers to absorb any material and take on its properties. He is the on-again-off-again husband of Titania, and an enemy of Thor and Hulk.

name: Adam and Eve
deck: Adam and Eve were protagonists of a one-shot story in Tales of Suspense. They were the last members of an old human civilization and the progenitors of a new one.

name: Adam Warlock
deck: Adam Warlock is a synthetic being created by human scientists named "The Enclave" to become their ideal template for a new race of humans who would rule the Earth. However, their creation, called "Him," rebelled, turned against them, and went on to become Adam Warlock.

name: Adolf Hitler
deck: The man who ruled over Nazi Germany during World War II. He wished to wipe leftists, Jews and other "inferiors" from the planet and rule over the world propagating an Aryan race agenda, an ideal that he oddly did not fall into himself.

name: Ael-Dan
deck: Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn took over the Kree Empire together

name: Agatha Harkness
deck: A renowned centuries-old witch, survivor of the Witch Trials and founder of New Salem. During the Age of Heroes she became the nanny of Franklin Richards and mentored the Scarlet Witch in the ways of witchcraft. She currently acts as an anti-hero and foil to her former pupil.

name: Agon
deck: The Father of Black Bolt and Maximus and the former king of the Inhumans.

name: Ak
deck: The hairy humanoid that adopted Tuk after his parents perished.

name: Alake
deck: Alake is a trained military commander with the standard abilities of the Shi'ar race.

name: Alberik
deck: Alberik is a member of the Axi-Tun.

name: Aleta Ogord
deck: Aleta Ogord was an Arcturan alien raised by her father, Ogord.

name: Alice Nugent
deck: One time Hank Pym's lab assistant, Alice Nugent was recruited by the cosmic Grandmaster to join his Squadron Sinister.

name: Alioth
deck: Master of timespan prior to that ruled by Kang.

name: Alkhema
deck: Alkhema, originally known as War Toy, was created by Ultron and had the brain patterns of Mockingbird.

name: Allie Magruder
deck: Allie Magruder was an employee of the organization known as the Superhuman Tactical Activities Response Squad (or S.T.A.R.S.). She was one of U.S.Agent's most trusted employees.

name: Amelia Voght
deck: Voght was a former nurse and partner to Charles Xavier. She left Xavier after he began forming the X-Men and later joined Magneto's Acolytes.

name: Amenhotep
deck: Amenhotep was an Egyptian Pharaoh who was dethroned and replaced by Rama-Tut (aka Kang the Conqueror).

name: American Dream
deck: Shannon Carter is the daughter of a typical mid-western family. Her father was a small town police officer, her mother was a school teacher, and her aunt is Peggy Carter. She joins Avengers Next.

name: Amphibian
deck: On a different Earth than our own a hero from the seven seas joins the premiere super team, the Squadron Supreme, as Amphibian. He was the resident aquatic member of the Squadron Supreme from Earth-712. The second Amphibian is a creature of mysterious origins.

name: Anelle
deck: Mother of Hulkling and Skrull Royalty.

name: Angar the Screamer
deck: A crook and companion to the Thunderbolt Songbird, after his death, she started a new life as a hero.

name: Angel
deck: A mutant and original member of the X-Men, Warren received his angelic wings at a young age along with a unique healing factor in his blood. After being twisted into a weapon of Apocalypse, Warren became the cold and distant Archangel. In the years since then, he's gone back and forth between his two identities.

name: Angel
deck: The Golden Age hero that had his debut in Marvel Comics #1 from Timely Comics. A doctor that became a costumed detective who had the "mystic cape of Mercury" that allowed him to fly.

name: Angela Lipscombe
deck: Angela Lipscombe once dated Bruce Banner. She has helped Bruce in his hour of need.

name: Aningan Kenojuak
deck: Aningan Kenojuak is an Inuit shaman. He found Captain America when he was frozen in ice.

name: Anna May Watson
deck: Anna May Watson is best friends with May Parker and a paternal aunt to Mary Jane Watson. Once the Watsons were neighbors to the Parkers in Forrest Hills.

name: Annihilus
deck: Annihilus, a native of the planet Arthos, is the ruler of the Negative Zone and longtime foe of the Fantastic Four. He is a nihilist who is obsessed with finding different ways to extend his lifespan and isn't opposed to destroying all that which he sees as a threat to his existence.

name: Ant-Man (Lang)
deck: Scott Lang is the second man to take up the mantle of Ant-Man. He has been a member of the Avengers and the Fantastic Four. He was notably killed during the events of Avengers: Disassembled and has struggled to get back on his feet ever since coming back from the dead.

name: Apocalypse
deck: One of the very first mutants, Apocalypse is both thousands of years old and a monstrous tyrant that has been a longtime foe of the X-Men. Apocalypse believes that only the strongest (whether mutant or superhuman) should survive. His body is a mix of organics and powerful celestial technology, boosting his shapeshifting and other powers to god-like levels.

name: Apocryphus
deck: Apocryphus is an Eternal pulled from his time period by Kang to defend Chronopolis.

name: Aquarius (Bentley)
deck: Aquarius is a member of the Zodiac

name: Aragorn
deck: The winged steed of Black Knight, and later Valkyrie.

name: Arcanna
deck: Arcanna is a powerful sorceress and member of the Squadron Supreme from the alternate universe of Earth-712.

name: Ares
deck: Ares is the son of Zeus and the Olympian God of War. After years of fighting against The Avengers, Thor, and mostly his own brother Hercules, Ares joined the ranks of the Avengers. He was a member of Tony Stark's official Avengers team and later Norman Osborn's Dark Avengers. After he attacked Osborn for tricking him in starting Siege on Asgard, he was stopped and killed by the Sentry.

name: Aries  (Raymond)
deck: Grover Raymond was the replacement for the original Aries in the human Zodiac Cartel

name: Aries (Lassiter)
deck: Marcus Lassiter was the first Aries in the original incarnation of the Zodiac Cartel.

name: Arishem the Judge
deck: Arishem the Judge is the leader of the Celestial hosts, and second-in-authority only to the One Above All. He judges the worthiness of species influenced by the Celestials, deciding which planets and its species will continue to live.

name: Arkon
deck: The imperial ruler of the extra-dimensional world of Polemachus. More recently, Arkon found himself in Weirdworld, a strange otherworldly dimension.

name: Arno Stark
deck: The real son of Howard and Maria Stark.

name: Aroke
deck: Lord Chamberlain of the Shi'ar

name: Ashema
deck: Ashema the Listener is the younger sister of The Dreaming Celestial and was a major player in the Heroes Reborn series.

name: Ast
deck: The first member of the Time-Keepers

name: Asti
deck: A mystical entity whom encountered Doctor Strange a few times.

name: Atlas
deck: Starting his super-criminal life as Power Man and then reinventing himself as the size-altering Goliath, Erik Josten has served as a member of several incarnations of the Masters of Evil and the Lethal Legion. It wasn't until he became Atlas and a founding Thunderbolts member that he truly "discovered" himself.

name: Attuma
deck: Attuma is a barbarian chief and citizen of Skarka. He believes he is destined to conquer Atlantis.

name: Aurora
deck: Aurora, the twin sister of Northstar, was a founding member of Alpha Flight. She also suffers from dissociative identity disorder, which often causes her to be caught in precarious situations.

name: Avalanche
deck: A former member of the new Brotherhood of Evil Mutants and Freedom Force. Avalanche has the ability to create vibratory waves that affects inorganic matter. He often uses his power to affect the earth.

name: Balder
deck: The Norse god of light, noble Asgardian warrior, and biological son of All-Father Odin and All-Mother Frigga, as well as half-brother and good friend of Thor. He is one of the bravest warriors of Asgard.

name: Baltag
deck: Baltag is an assassin that used to work for Kang.

name: Balthakk
deck: An ancient energy being . Doesn't have any real form.

name: Bambi Arbogast
deck: After serving as Tony Stark's secretary for many years, Bambi Arbogast became a manager for one of Stark's companies. She also worked for the Heroes for Hire Corporation, and remains a good friend to Tony Stark.

name: Banshee
deck: Banshee was a mutant with a sonic scream. Born in Ireland, he pursued a career in Interpol, the X-Men, Generation X as Co-Headmaster, and founded X-Corp. He was the father of Theresa Cassidy as well as Black Tom Cassidy's cousin. He has since become bonded to the Spirit of Variance.

name: Baron Gregor Russoff
deck: Baron Gregor Russoff is an ancestor of Jack Russell who terrorized Transia as a werewolf and later became a thrall of Chthon.

name: Baron Heinrich Zemo
deck: Dr. Heinrich Zemo was the 12th Baron Zemo and a Nazi war criminal. He is one of Captain America's greatest foes.

name: Baron Helmut Zemo
deck: The 13th Baron in the Zemo bloodline. Helmut followed in the footsteps of his father before him, becoming an enemy of Captain America and the Avengers. In what could be his greatest scheme ever, Helmut masqueraded as Citizen V and led the Thunderbolts to public acclaim in order to conquer the world. In the end, he failed only because his cohorts desired to remain heroes and rebelled against him.

name: Batman
deck: Bruce Wayne, who witnessed the murder of his billionaire parents as a child, swore to avenge their deaths. He trained extensively to achieve mental and physical perfection, mastering martial arts, detective skills, and criminal psychology. Costumed as a bat to prey on the fears of criminals, and utilizing a high-tech arsenal, he became the legendary Batman.

name: Batroc
deck: Mercenary, formerly of the French Foreign Legion. He is one of the most formidable unarmed combatants in the world. He has mastered numerous martial arts and is perhaps the world's leading master of Savate, the French art of kick boxing. He is an accomplished thief and smuggler.

name: Beast
deck: A founding member of the X-Men, Dr. Hank McCoy is a mutant possessing animal-like strength and agility. Despite being covered in blue fur and resembling a ferocious beast, Hank possesses an astounding intellect and a superb wit. He is currently a key member of X-Force.

name: Bedlam
deck: Olisa Kabaki, a woman that became the avatar of Ikonn, one of the deities who took part in the Wager of the Octessence.

name: Benedict
deck: The tentacled robot known as Benedict became an enemy of the Avengers after infiltrating their mansion, defeating most of the team and sowing paranoia and unease within their ranks. He later also fought the team as a member of the Inner Guard and battled against Count Nefaria and the Grim Reaper.

name: Beta Ray Bill
deck: The cyborg champion of the Korbinites, Beta Ray Bill guarded his people as they fled attacks by fire demons. When he encountered Thor and proved himself worthy to wield Mjolnir, Odin bestowed upon him the powers of Thor, as well as Stormbreaker, an equally powerful hammer. Using this new weapon, Beta Ray Bill would travel the cosmos righting wrongs, but he was always available whenever Thor needed his assistance.

name: Betsy Braddock
deck: British beauty Elizabeth Braddock is older twin sister of Captain Britain a mutant, former fashion model, and Charter Pilot. She is a long-standing member of the X-Men, Leader of Excalibur, and Founder of the reformed Captain Britain Corps, multi-versal alternate versions of herself.

name: Betty Dean
deck: A policewoman in the 1940's. She often helped out Namor during World War II

name: Betty Ross
deck: The love of Bruce Banner's life, she has been one of the Hulk's greatest allies, though she is the daughter of his greatest enemy, General 'Thunderbolt' Ross. She has been transformed into the Harpy, died, and is now a Hulk herself although she lost her powers when Doctor Green, the new incarnation of the Hulk, injected her with the cure for Gamma Radiation. What's next in her life remains to be seen...

name: Bia
deck: Partners with Kratos, Bia is the personification of force and wields a mace forged by Cyclopes.

name: Bishop
deck: Lucas Bishop is a mutant from the 22nd century that traveled into the past, becoming a member of the X-Men, and later, the Uncanny X-Force. He has the mutant ability to absorb and redirect any kinetic energy that is used against him or that is released in his general vicinity. He is the first black male team member within the X-Men Universe.

name: Black Bolt
deck: The king of the Inhumans, Black Bolt is cursed and blessed with a quasi-sonic voice. He must remain forever silent, for with the slightest whisper he can destroy cities, and with the loudest screams he can level continents.

name: Black Brigade
deck: Ex-Russian Cyborg Mercenary

name: Black Goliath
deck: Brilliant and tough, Goliath fought evil using a variation of the Pym Particles. He was killed during the Civil War by Ragnarok, a clone of Thor. He was succeeded by his nephew, Tom Foster.

name: Black Knight
deck: The latest wielder of the Ebony Blade in a long line of heroes and villains known as the Black Knight.

name: Black Knight (Garrett)
deck: The second Black Knight, this time an evil villain. He is the uncle of Dane Whitman.

name: Black Mamba
deck: Former call girl and member of many organizations, most notably the Serpent Society and B.A.D. Girls Inc.

name: Black Panther
deck: T'Challa is the Black Panther, king of Wakanda, one of the most technologically advanced nations on Earth. He is among the top intellects and martial artists of the world, a veteran Avenger, and a member of the Illuminati. Using his powers and abilities, he has pledged his fortune, powers, and life to the service of all mankind.

name: Black Widow
deck: Former KGB agent Natalia Alianovna Romanova, known as the Black Widow Natasha Romanoff, was trained by the top-secret Soviet brainwashing and training program the Red Room to become the ultimate "Super-Spy". She defected from the Soviet Union to the US, joining S.H.I.E.L.D., and later Black Widow became a long-standing member of The Avengers. She is a woman with an enigmatic past and red in her ledger.

name: Blackheath
deck: A supervillain who later joined the Thunderbolts seeking redemption.

name: Blackout
deck: Blackout is a super-villain who can manipulate Darkforce matter and energy and open portals to it's dimension. He formerly worked alongside Moonstone and subsequently joined the Masters of Evil and later the Thunderbolts.

name: Blake Burdick
deck: Blake Burdick is a police officer and the new husband of Peggy Rae, ex-wife of Scott Lang (Ant-Man) and Cassie Lang (Stature)

name: Blastaar
deck: A denizen of the Negative Zone who battles Annihilus frequently and became the king of most of the territories of the Negative Zone

name: Blazing Skull
deck: A war-time hero, the Blazing Skull was an ally to the Invaders and remains active to this day although with far less sanity. In modern times he has fought alongside Thin Man's Invaders squad and the Defenders.

name: Blob
deck: A common enemy of the X-Men and one of the most unusual mutants, who was de-powered during M-Day. His Age of Apocalypse counterpart has since replaced him in his various villainous roles after leaving his home reality.

name: Blood Brothers
deck: The Blood Brothers were two linked alien brothers who served as minions of Thanos.

name: Bloodwraith
deck: Enemy of the Black Knight, Bloodwraith enjoys taking lives, including innocent ones.

name: Blue Shield
deck: Blue Shield is crimefighter who sought to destroy the mob from within.

name: Bolt
deck: Bolt was a mutant with the power to absorb and channel electrostatic energy. He idolized the mutant Maverick, even taking his namesake and look after the original disappeared.

name: Bova
deck: A human-cow hybrid created by the High Evolutionary, Bova is somewhat of a professional nursemaid; having in large part singlehandedly raised both Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch at Wundagore Mountain.

name: Brahl
deck: Brahl is a devious member of the villain teams Force and the Minions of Menace

name: Brain
deck: Member of the Midnight Wreckers and ally to Machine Man.

name: Brain-Child
deck: Brain-Child is a ten year old with supreme intelligence. On his tenth birthday, he attempted to destroy the world.

name: Bravado
deck: Bravado is the son of Thor and Enchantress on Earth-9811

name: Bron Char
deck: A Kree soldier and member of the Lunatic Legion who wants revenge on Humans for the Kree Empire's defeat and death of the Supreme Intelligence during the Kree/Shi'ar war.

name: Brother Royal
deck: Leader of the Brotherhood of Badoon.

name: Brutus
deck: Brutus is a member of Madame Masque's Inner Guard.

name: Bucky Barnes
deck: Believed dead near the end of World War II only to have been found and brainwashed by the Soviets for the next 50 years, Captain America's former sidekick now continues to defend his country from the shadows against those who would threaten it as legendary spy and assassin, the Winter Soldier. He became the new Captain America to honor his friend Steve and he joined the Avengers. When Steve returned as Captain America, Bucky took on the identity of the Winter Soldier once again.

name: Bulldozer
deck: A U.S. army sergeant who was discharged and put into jail. He later became one of the strongest members of The Wrecking Crew.

name: Byrrah
deck: Byrrah is a Golden Age creation of Bill Everett. He is the step-son of Emperor Tha-Korr, Namor's grandfather. Byrrah has tried several times to take the throne of Atlantis for himself.

name: Cable
deck: The once-mysterious Cable (a.k.a. Nathan Summers) is Cyclops' time-traveling son who was infected with the deadly techno-organic virus during his infancy, which he keeps at bay using his advanced psionic powers. At one time a founding member and leader of the militant team called X-Force, previously known as the New Mutants, Cable takes the aimless youths under his wing and whips them into fighting shape in order to prepare them for future threats.

name: Cactus
deck: Cactus is a humanoid cactus plant created by Dominus. He attacks with his sharp needles and has the ability to regenerate certain body parts.

name: Cagliostro
deck: Cagliostro is a black magician from the 18th Century who has been able to live for hundreds of years thanks to his knowledge of spells that maintain his youthful age. He has a strong rivalry with Dracula.

name: Cancer (Klevano)
deck: Member of The Zodiac

name: Candy Southern
deck: Candy Southern was the girlfriend of the X-Man, Angel. She supported him during his time with the Champion, and even became leader of the Defenders. Later, she was kidnapped, tortured and eventually murdered for their relationship.

name: Cannonball
deck: Cannonball is a mutant with the ability to propel himself through the air like a human rocket. Over the years, Sam Guthrie has grown from a New Mutant, to the leader of the original X-Force, to a full-fledged member of the X-Men. He's currently a U.S. Avenger.

name: Capricorn (Weir)
deck: member of Zodiac.

name: Captain America
deck: During World War II, Steve Rogers volunteered to receive the experimental Super-Soldier Serum. Enhanced to the pinnacle of human physical potential and armed with an unbreakable shield, he became Captain America. After a failed mission left him encased in ice for decades, he was found and revived by the Avengers, later joining their ranks and eventually becoming the team's leader.

name: Captain Assyria
deck: Member of the Avengers on Earth-9105.

name: Captain Atlas
deck: Captain Atlas is a warrior and decorated Captain of the Kree military who worked with Doctor Minerva during Operation: Galactic Storm.

name: Captain Britain
deck: Chosen by Merlyn, Brian Braddock became Captain Britain: protector of Great Britain and the Omniverse. He is a founding member and leader of Excalibur, twin brother of the X-Man Psylocke, an agent of MI:13, and is currently Captain Avalon.

name: Captain Marvel
deck: A captain in the Kree militia, Mar-Vell rebelled against a racist tyrannical empire to defend Earth and in so doing became the "Protector of the Universe" known as Captain Marvel. Since his tragic death to cancer, Captain Marvel has inspired many superheroes and heroines and his legacy is still felt throughout the Marvel universe.

name: Captain Ultra
deck: A lesser-known hero, Captain Ultra is nonetheless one of the cool guys of Marvel.

name: Carina Walters
deck: Collector's daughter and the wife of Michael Korvac.

name: Carnivore
deck: Andreas Zorba became Carnivore when he touched the Fearsome Fist of Farallah .

name: Carol Danvers
deck: After encountering the Kree hero Captain Marvel, Carol Danvers was accidentally subjected to otherworldly radiation that transformed her into a superhuman warrior. Calling herself Ms. Marvel, she established herself as one of the most powerful and prominent heroes and respected member of the Avengers. She has now adopted the mantle of Captain Marvel for herself.

name: Cary St. Lawrence
deck: A soldier of the U.S. Military whom fought against the Hulk a couple of times

name: Cassie Lang
deck: The daughter of Scott Lang and a member of the Young Avengers. She has the same ability to shrink and grow in size as her father, gained through utilizing Pym Particles.

name: Catman
deck: Cat-Man was a costumed super-hero who was published by a golden age publisher, Holyoke, from 1940 through 1946.

name: Cerise
deck: An member of the Shi'ar Empire who hid out on Earth, joined Excalibur and dated Nightcrawler before being pardoned for her crimes

name: Cesium
deck: The Elements of Doom are recreated by AIM. Cesium is another dangerous member.

name: Chandu
deck: Chandu the Alchemist was a 12th century Mystic and would be conqueror.

name: Charcoal
deck: Charles Burlingame was transformed into a stone-like entity by Arnim Zola. He joined the Thunderbolts but died during one of their missions.

name: Charles Magnus
deck: Magnus is a sorcerer, as well as a friend and tutor to Jessica Drew, the Spider-woman. One of his main advisories is Morgan le Fey.

name: Charlie-27
deck: Co-Founder of the 31st century superhero group, Guardians of the Galaxy, he is the last survivor of a race genetically engineered to live on Jupiter.

name: Chili Storm
deck: Chili Storm is Millie Collins' most enduring supporting character. A fellow model, Chili has served as a co-worker, close friend and business rival of Millie.

name: Chthon
deck: Chthon is an Elder God and Archdemon that resides in a nether dimension adjacent to the earthly plane. He is responsible for the creation of Witches, Werewolves and Vampires and is portrayed as the equivalent of the primal Devil that predates the Judeo-Christian teachings.

name: Clea
deck: Clea is the heroic daughter of Umar and the niece of Dormammu. She is also Doctor Strange's estranged wife and was the ruler of The Dark Dimension until her Uncle usurped her throne and regained his.

name: Cloak
deck: Tyrone Johnson is the "dark" half of the vigilante duo known as Cloak and Dagger. After a drug-related experiment awakened his powers, he became a living personification of darkness. Cloak is the Yin to his partner Dagger's Yang. Superheroes of the streets, Cloak and Dagger wage a war against dangerous drugs and drug-related crimes.

name: Coal Tiger
deck: T'Chaka is the alternate future time line son of T'Challa, known as the Black Panther and King of Wakanda.

name: Collector
deck: The Collector Taneleer Tivan is one of the oldest living beings in the Universe. His species at Cygnus X-1 was one of the first to evolve after the Big Bang. ... Tivan spent the first millennia of his existence with his wife, Matani, and daughter, Carina, on a planet he chose as his headquarters..

name: Colossus
deck: Piotr Rasputin is a Russian mutant who possesses the ability to transform his body into organic steel, giving him immense strength and durability. Colossus is among the physically strongest X-Men, and is a talented artist.

name: Conquest
deck: Conquest, one of the eight Exemplars, is pure combat incarnated.

name: Corruptor
deck: The Corruptor was a worker at a pharmaceutical company who manufactured psychoactive substances. He was exposed to the chemicals in a fire and gained the ability to bring out others worst tendencies.

name: Count Nefaria
deck: Originally, Count Nefaria was just an ambitious Maggia Don who hired mad scientists and super-villains. Later, becoming super-powered himself. Luchino stands as one of the Avengers' most powerful enemies, though not one of their most recurring.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Bukharin)
deck: Former KGB operative known as the Crimson Dynamo and Airstrike. After primarily being an Iron Man villain, he's now a member of the Russian superhero team, the Winter Guard.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Nevsky)
deck: An assistant to Anton Vanko, Nevsky was sent to rebuild the Dynamo and gain revenge on Iron Man.

name: Crossfire
deck: A former CIA Agent who became a criminal and organized an army of mercenaries, Crossfire lost his left eye and left ear in an explosion, replacing them with cybernetic implants. He primarily antagonizes Hawkeye, and by extension Mockingbird and the Avengers. However, he ultimately goes where the money is.

name: Crystal
deck: Crystal is a member of the Inhumans and the younger sister of Medusa, Queen of the Inhumans. She has the power to manipulate the four classical elements of Air, Fire, Water and Earth.

name: Cyclone
deck: A French gangster who inherited the Cyclone suit and name from the deceased villain Andre Gerard. Has worked with the Maggia and Justine Hammer's Masters of Evil, and even briefly operated as a member of Hawkeye's heroic Thunderbolts.

name: Cyclops
deck: The first X-Man, Scott Summers possesses the mutant ability to fire powerful concussive blasts through his eyes that act as a portal to another dimension full of the force that makes up his optic blast. He is visually distinctive for the ruby quartz visor he wears to control his devastating power. A born leader, Cyclops succeeded his mentor Professor X to command the X-Men.

name: Cyttorak
deck: Cyttorak is an immensely powerful deity, ruler of the Crimson Cosmos and supplier of power to his avatar, the unstoppable Juggernaut.

name: Dakimh
deck: Dakimh is a powerful sorceror of earth's dimension.

name: Dallas Riordan
deck: Dallas Riordan was originally the Thunderbolts mayoral liaison then became their enemy as Citizen V. Eventually joining the team and merged with Atlas before being the ion-powered Vantage. She has worked with the NYPD, V-Battalion, Department of Homeland Security and most recently the Commission for Superhuman Activities.

name: Dar-Ben
deck: Dar-Ben and Ael-Dan ruled the Kree Empire together

name: Daredevil
deck: As a child, Matt Murdock was blinded by radioactive waste while trying to save an elderly stranger about to get hit by a truck carrying the dangerous material. In turn, his other senses were heightened to superhuman sharpness and he gained a form of "radar sense". By day, he is a successful trial lawyer; but by night, he guards Hell's Kitchen as Daredevil: the Man Without Fear.

name: Daredevil
deck: A young boy named David Jarret whom was seemingly the last normal person on Earth. That was untill he died, and seemingly had the power to revive himself. In adulthood, he became Daredevil, a circus performer with the inability to die and be reborn despite his best wishes.

name: Darkhawk
deck: As a teenager, Chris Powell discovered an amulet allowing him to don the alien armor of Darkhawk. Belonging to an ancient sect of Shi'ar assassins known as the Fraternity of Raptors, it provides immense protective and fighting power to its wearer along with access to its Datasong which grants the ability to access memories and possible future outcomes of events.

name: Darkstar (Petrovna)
deck: Vanguard's fraternal twin sister. The first Darkstar, Laynia Petrovna is a mutant capable of manipulating an immeasurable amount of darkforce energy. She lived and died in service to her mother country Russia, but was later resurrected in the body of the previous Darkstar, Reena Stancioff, when Reena was transformed into a Dire Wraith.

name: Dave Anderson
deck: Former head of security at Los Diablos Missile Base.

name: Dazzler
deck: A mutant with the ability to transduce sound into light, which often forces her into reluctant superheroism. She is also a very gifted singer and performer, hence her reservations in donning her uniform.

name: Death
deck: The personification of Death in the Marvel Universe and the twin sister of Oblivion.

name: Death's Head II
deck: Created in the year 2020 by Dr. Evelyn Necker of A.I.M., Death's Head II's psyche consists of 106 different personalities including that of the original Death's Head.

name: Deathbird
deck: Deathbird is the older sister of Lilandra Neramani and D'Ken. She deposed her sister and has ruled the Shi'ar Empire twice. She was married to Vulcan (Gabriel Summers).

name: Deathcry
deck: Sharra Neramani is a young and skilled Shi'ar warrior, who joined the Avengers, when she was exiled to Earth, and took upon the name Deathcry.

name: Deathlok
deck: Created by the military, Deathlok is a Cyborg from the future in the mainstream Marvel Universe, and several alternate universes as well, whom wishes to regain his lost humanity.

name: Decay
deck: Decay's powers cause organic life around him to die and non-organic life to erode.

name: Demolition Man
deck: A former professional wrestler, Demolition Man has had a dubious and difficult career as a costumed adventurer. Although he began as one of Captain America’s closest allies during a difficult time for the patriotic hero, much of his life following that has proven hard. Recently he has started working as Sam Wilson's pilot and field back up.

name: Demon Druid
deck: Ultimus aka. Demon Druid is a Kree Eternal. He is the only Kree Eternal to still be alive though.

name: Derek Freeman
deck: Derek Freeman is an FBI agent, brother to one-time Avengers liaison Duane Freeman and a close ally to Monica Rambeau.

name: Destiny
deck: A blind woman with precognitive mutant-powers. Destiny was part of the Brotherhood of (Evil) Mutants and one of the few people Mystique truly loved. She was killed by Legion.

name: Destroyer (Marlow)
deck: Keene Marlow was a Golden Age hero of Marvel's predecessor Timely Comics. In the 1970's Destroyer was retconned into Brian Falsworth, heir & successor to the title Union Jack. Marlow later appeared as an aged hero who set out to kill all supervillians before dying of heart failure.

name: Destructor
deck: Super Criminal Genius who merged with The Doomsday Man .

name: Devil Dinosaur
deck: A huge red dinosaur that resembles that of a Tyrannosaurus who has an amazing bond with Moon-Boy, and later Moon Girl.

name: Devos The Devastator
deck: Devos the Devastator's sole responsibility is to eliminate every life form that has any prospect of ever waging war.

name: Diablo
deck: Diablo is a 9th century alchemist with aspirations of world dominance. He is able to produce any number of amazing potions that defy scientific analysis. Diablo does not seem to age. He is an enemy of the Fantastic Four.

name: Django Maximoff
deck: Django is, apparently, the true father of the Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver. He had raised them, but until recently it was believed that Erik (Magneto) and Magda Lensherr where the twins' biological parents.

name: Doc Samson
deck: Gamma-irradiated friend, rival, and psychiatrist of Bruce Banner. Once possessing the superhuman strength equivalent to a relatively calm Hulk, Leonard is now more powerful than ever as his darker alter-ego Samson. Incalculable strength, virtually limitless endurance and an extremely high degree of durability.

name: Doctor Doom
deck: The very mention of his name makes lesser men tremble! The brilliant scientist whose iron mask conceals his scarred (but once handsome) face! Master of science and sorcery, Victor Von Doom is the monarch of Latveria, attempting the betterment of humanity through world conquest! Unequaled and unrivaled in every manner, Doctor Doom has had many conflicts with both earthly and cosmic super-beings, but he will always be known as the eternal nemesis of Reed Richards and his accursed Fantastic Four!

name: Doctor Druid
deck: Doctor Druid was a psychiatrist who was attracted to the mystic arts. After being trained by a Tibetan Lama, Druid gained mastery over some mystic arts.

name: Doctor Octopus
deck: Doctor Octopus is a supervillain originating from Marvel Comics. A former nuclear physicist and atomic researcher, Otto Octavius' life changed forever when one of his experiments went horribly wrong involving his four mechanical appendages used to assist him in his experiments. From then on, Octavius soon after his initial encounter has become one of the most dangerous supervillains in the Marvel Universe.

name: Doctor Spectrum
deck: Joseph Ledger is a former astronaut who is given a prism of power to become the superhero known as Doctor Spectrum. He is a founding member of the Squadron Supreme. There have been several versions of this hero in the alternate universe's of Marvel Comics.

name: Doctor Strange
deck: Dr. Stephen Strange was once a gifted but egotistical surgeon who sought out the Ancient One to heal his hands after they were wounded in a car accident. Instead, the Ancient One trained him to become Master of the Mystic Arts and the Sorcerer Supreme of Earth.

name: Dominex
deck: Dominex was created by the Quist in order to destroy any planet they were unable to take over.

name: Dominus
deck: Dominus is a super computer, built by an alien race and operated by robots. It was later used by Cable to substitute for his loss of his telepathy.

name: Donald Blake
deck: Donald Blake was created by Odin to be an alter-ego of Thor so he could learn humility. They are now two separate beings

name: Doomsday Man
deck: An indestructible robot created by the US government that merged with a human. Doomsday Man is a recurring villain of Carol Danvers.

name: Dormammu
deck: Dormammu is the older twin brother of Umar and Ruler of the Dark Dimension, a being of immense mystical power. He uses his vast powers to conquer other universes and dimensions, earning himself the enmity of Doctor Strange in the process.

name: Dorothy Walker
deck: The mother of Patsy Walker.

name: Dorrek VII
deck: Emperor Dorrek VII captured the Illuminati and began the infiltration experiments.

name: Dr. Michael Barnett
deck: Michael Barnett was a talented psychologist who helped Carol Danvers come to terms with her dual identity as Ms. Marvel. He was murdered by Carol's archenemy, Mystique.

name: Dr. Minerva
deck: The blue skinned Kree genetic scientist and spy to the home-world of Kree-Lar found Captain Mar-Vell's genetic attributes as a viable mate. Gaining similar powers to Ms.Marvel she joined the Kree Starforce and later would be a major player in the end of the aging Kree Empire.

name: Dr. Vasily Khandruvitch
deck: Russian scientist who created the 'Elements of Doom'

name: Dracula
deck: The Original Count Dracula from Bram Stoker's famous novel. His character has been explored in many comics, including those released by Marvel, DC and many other publishers.

name: Drang
deck: Supreme Commander of the Eastern Sector of the Brotherhood of Badoon

name: Drax the Destroyer
deck: After he and his family were killed by Thanos, Arthur Douglas was recreated as Drax the Destroyer by Mentor and Kronos with the sole purpose of destroying Thanos. He later joined the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Dreadnought
deck: Dreadnought was created for combat by Hydra

name: Duane Freeman
deck: Government liaison.

name: Dum Dum Dugan
deck: Dum Dum Dugan served with Nick Fury's Howling Commandos during WWII. He later became Fury's second in command at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his closest friends. Dugan, now struggling with identity issues since he was revealed to be a LMD.

name: Dumog
deck: Member of the Minions of Menace

name: Dynorr the Stalker
deck: Dynorr was an Alpha Centaurian alien who led an invasion force to Earth. He encountered Namor whom defeated him.

name: Ebony
deck: Agatha Harkness' mystical black cat.

name: Eel (Lavell)
deck: Edward Lavell took the mantle of the Eel from the deceased Leopold Stryke, and has upgraded his armor and technology to enhance his criminal lifestyle.

name: Egghead
deck: Egghead is a loathsome scientist who quickly became a nemesis to Hank Pym.

name: Ego
deck: Ego is an intelligent, living planet that is millions of years old and devours anything in its path.

name: El Aguila
deck: A modern day Robin Hood, Alejandro Montoya has the power to shoot bursts of electricity through metal conductors.

name: Electron
deck: Electron is a long-time member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard who has been both a friend and foe to the various heroes of Earth.

name: Elfqueen
deck: Elfqueen is a sorceress with super strength, durability & a number of other powers.

name: Elysius
deck: Elysius was genetically engineered in the Life-Baths of Titan by ISAAC. She has a son (Genis-Vell) and daughter (Phyla), and was a lover of Mar-Vell.

name: Ember
deck: Slorenian Hero

name: Enchantress
deck: Amora the Enchantress, an Asgardian Goddess and immensely powerful sorcerer. Being backed by years of experience, she is one of Thor’s greatest and most ruthless foes because of her immense power, and because he is her love interest.

name: Eobar Garrington
deck: Black Knight during the Crusades, was possessed by a time-travelling Dane Whitman.

name: Ernest Carrothers
deck: The Wasp's Chauffeur.

name: Eson the Searcher
deck: Eson the Searcher's sole duty is to seek out specimes for Gammenon to gather.

name: Eternal Brain
deck: After his body was murdered, scientist William Carmody's brain survived.

name: Eternity
deck: Eternity is an abstract, relatively omnipotent entity representing all time and reality in the universe. His twin sister is Infinity, and his other siblings are Death, Oblivion and Galactus. Eternity has been around before the beginning of the universe. He is eternal.

name: Eternity Man
deck: Jason Beere was an Avengers villain who after discovering he was terminally ill decided to plant bombs so the world would die with him.

name: Executioner
deck: Skurge is an Asgardian warrior and one time enemy of Thor. For a long time, he was being used by Amora, the Enchantress, however, he earned redemption when he sacrificed himself to save countless souls from Niflheim. He occasionally gets a free pass from Valhalla to continue proving his heroism.

name: Fabian Cortez
deck: Though a member of Magneto's Acolytes, Cortez often rebelled against him.

name: Fandral
deck: Fandral the Dashing is a charter member of the Warriors Three, a trio of Asgardian adventurers consisting of Fandral, Hogun the Grim, and Volstagg the Valiant. They are members of the supporting cast in Marvel's Thor comics and usually provide comic relief and side-adventures.

name: Fantom of the Fair
deck: Public Domain Character.

name: Farallah
deck: Farallah is one of the entities that was one of the Octessence, and for his part in the Wager created the Fearsome Fist of Farallah, which powered the Exemplar, Carnivore.

name: Farley Mowat
deck: An agent of the Superhuman Tactical Activities Response Squad, better known as S.T.A.R.S.

name: Fawkes
deck: Fawkes is a member of Madame Masque's Inner Guard.

name: Fighting Yank
deck: The Fighting Yank is a Superhero who fought in World War II.

name: Firebird
deck: Born a hero the night a fireball from the heavens landed near her on her walk home from church, Bonita Juarez became Firebird. She has fought as a member of both Avengers and West Coast teams, and the Southwest-based superteam the Rangers.

name: Firelord
deck: The Firelord started life as Pyreus Kril on the planet Xander home to the legendary Nova Corps. He was once one of the Heralds of Galactus.

name: Firestar
deck: Trained to be an assassin with her microwave-manipulating mutant powers, Angelica Jones instead grew to be the popular hero Firestar. A founding member of New Warriors, Firestar has also played a key role as part of the Avengers and X-Men.

name: Fixer
deck: A technological genius, Fixer pursued a life of crime as a partner to Mentallo and later a member of the Masters of Evil. He later became a founding member of the heroic Thunderbolts and despite hating the idea of being a hero and has remained a mainstay ever since.

name: Fiz
deck: A mutant Skrull with the ability to change his size.

name: Flashfire
deck: An alien who is a member of The Imperial Guard of the Shi'ar Empire. He can be considered a veteran.

name: Flying Dutchman
deck: A cursed Dutch pirate and former minion of Mephisto.

name: Foggy Nelson
deck: Matt Murdock's best friend and almost as good a lawyer as Matt himself. They work together in their own law firm.

name: Frank Rambeau
deck: Frank Rambeau is the father of Monica Rambeau (Photon). He is an aging officer of the New Orleans Fire Department. He has a heart condition.

name: Frankenstein
deck: The infamous monster-creation of Victor Frankenstein. The Monster roams the Marvel Universe and has encountered a number of Marvel heroes and villains over the years.

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
deck: The 32nd President of the United States of America. He served as the President for the majority of the Second World War.

name: Franklin Richards
deck: Franklin is the son of Reed Richards and Sue Storm, also known as Mr. Fantastic and Invisible Woman of the Fantastic Four. Franklin is an Omega-level mutant with reality-warping abilities; even at a young age he is one of the most powerful beings in the Universe.

name: Franz Gruber
deck: Formerly the late Baron Heinrich Zemo's pilot. He later went on to impersonate Zemo after he later studied notes he left behind in an attempt to use an earth orbiting death ray in order to take over the world.

name: Fred Davis
deck: A baseball player who took up the mantle of Bucky to trick the Red Skull when the Invaders were brainwashed. Months later, he officially became the second Bucky.

name: Freebooter
deck: Protege of Hawkeye and a member of A-Next.

name: Future Man
deck: Would be conqueror from the future.

name: Gaea
deck: Gaea is one of the Elder Gods and mother to all the pantheon of Gods on Earth. She is known as Mother Earth and embodies the spirit of life, harvest and renewal on Earth. Gaea is associated with all the creatures of the Earth as well as the Human Race.

name: Galactus
deck: Galactus is the infamous "Devourer of Worlds" in the Marvel Universe. His powers are nearly omnipotent. He has appointed several entities as his Heralds, imbuing them with the Power Cosmic. He uses energy from the core of planets and universal sources to sustain himself.

name: Galen Kor
deck: Galen-Kor, former admiral in the Kree military and head of covert operations turned vindictive survivalist of its remnants. Having survived the first Kree/Shi'ar war, he led a unit of Kree soldiers to get vengeance on both the Shi'ar and Avengers for the events that transpired in Operation: Galactic Storm.

name: Gambit
deck: A charming master thief and skilled martial artist who became a member of the X-Men, Gambit possesses the mutant ability to change potential energy in inanimate objects into kinetic energy which causes them to explode. His signature move is throwing kinetically-charged playing cards at his opponents.

name: Gamora
deck: The sole surviving member of the Zen Whoberi, Gamora, was saved as a child by Thanos. Through Thanos' augmentation and training she became a highly skilled and feared galactic assassin. Using her new formidable skills and abilities, she gained the reputation and title of The Deadliest Woman in the Universe. She eventually turned good and became a member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Gargoyle
deck: A Soviet scientist mutated by radiation and the first foe of the Hulk. He was later cured by Bruce Banner.

name: Gemini
deck: members of the Zodiac

name: General Colton
deck: General Joseph B. Colton graduated with the highest honors from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 1960, where he was then selected by former president John F. Kennedy to create and command America's elite fighting force, codename G.I. Joe making him the very first real American hero.

name: General McGinty
deck: U.S. Military General and member of the Pentagon staff who commanded a Sentinel assault upon Kang.

name: Genis-Vell
deck: Cloned from the DNA of the Kree warrior Mar-Vell, Genis-Vell was implanted with false memories making him believe he was instead Starfox's son. He was then artificially aged so that he'd be ready to face Mar-Vell's enemies. He inherited the title of Captain Marvel, but succumbed to the madness of Cosmic Awareness as he became nearly omnipotent and sought to "fix" the universe. He redeemed himself afterwards and became part of the Thunderbolts, where he took the title of Photon and was killed by Baron Zemo.

name: Geometer
deck: Extra-terrestrial enemy of Quasar

name: George Pérez
deck: An artist who has appeared in comics on numerous occations

name: George W. Bush
deck: George Bush was the 43rd President of the United States of America. His father George W. H. Bush was the 41st President. He has owned companies, sporting, and his own ranch in Texas. He was in the Air Force National Guard.

name: Ghost Rider (Blaze)
deck: Johnny Blaze, a motorcycle stuntman, became bound to the Spirit of Vengeance known as Zarathos after making a deal with Mephisto to spare the life of his surrogate father. With the power to control hellfire and to inflict pain on those he deems evil with his Penance Stare, Johnny seeks vengeance as Ghost Rider.

name: Gila
deck: Gila is a humanoid gila monster created by Dominus.

name: Gilgamesh
deck: His true name lost in the mists of time, The Forgotten One is a member of the immortal race called the Eternals. He has been known by many names but he is once more who he must ever be: The Forgotten One.

name: Gladiator
deck: Kallark, codenamed Gladiator, was once the Praetor of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard, the most faithful servant of the Shi'ar throne. After the Shi'ar-Kree War, with the apparent death of Lilandra and Vulcan, Kallark is elevated to the position of Majestor by consensus of a desperate Shi'ar populace.

name: Gladiator (Potter)
deck: One of Daredevil's first enemies who eventually reformed and became one of his supporters.

name: Glenn Talbot
deck: Glenn Talbot was a major in the U.S. Air Force who hunted the Hulk with Gen. Ross. He later married Betty Ross, but they divorced. He later became a Colonel. He recently resurfaced in the Fall of the Hulks storyline.

name: Glomm
deck: In the period when Kang declared war on Earth, Glomm who was a being produced by the Deviants, rebelled against the empire and became a soldier serving under Dulpus.

name: Golden Archer
deck: Wyatt McDonald is the finest archer of Earth-712, home to the Squadron Supreme. However, despite his brilliant skills, he has been removed from the Squadron for brainwashing his former girlfriend, Lady Lark.

name: Golden Girl
deck: Golden Girl was a Golden Age heroine who once served as Captain America's sidekick.

name: Gorgon
deck: As a result of being exposed to the Terrigen Mist when he was an infant, Gorgon developed hooved feet and a powerful lower body. His legs are so powerful that with a single stomp, he can create shock tremors to disable his opponents.

name: Gorilla-Man
deck: A mercenary who was cursed to be stuck in the body of an immortal gorilla. He is one of Marvel's oldest characters and member of the Agents of Atlas, named for the former name of Marvel Comics.

name: Gorr
deck: Gorr is a Kronan who fought Thor.

name: Grand Director
deck: Steven Rogers [formely William Burnside] was the fourth Captain America and was active in the 1950s. He has resurfaced since often fronting extremist causes and appearing as an antagonist to the real Captain America.

name: Grandmaster
deck: An incredibly ancient being, the Grandmaster possesses a high level of cosmic power.

name: Graviton
deck: Graviton was a physicist, named Franklin Hall, who was involved in an experiment in a private research facility in the Canadian Rockies. A mistake in Hall's calculations causes graviton particles to merge with his own molecules, and Hall later discovers that he can mentally control gravity.

name: Green Lama
deck: Green Lama's first appearance was in December 1940, during the Golden Age of Comics. He is now a key figure in Dynamite Entertainment's comic "Project SuperPowers". He is also a new member of Masks, Dynamite Entertainments new vigilante team. The character is owned by the Crossen Estate.

name: Grey Gargoyle
deck: The Grey Gargoyle can turn his body into stone and others into stone for a period of one hour.

name: Griffin (Franklin)
deck: A former member of the Circus of Crime, Griffin is a gamma-irradiated member of the Gamma Corps.

name: Grim Reaper
deck: Eric Williams is the brother of Wonder Man who was killed and brought back to life using black magic. As the Grim Reaper, Eric has fought The Avengers numerous times and harbors a hatred for the Vision - whose brainwaves were copied from Eric's brother - and Wonder Man himself, believing he is an imposter of the real Simon Williams.

name: Grott
deck: Member of the Minions of Menace

name: Gullin
deck: The Boar-God

name: Gundar
deck: Gundar was a Viking captain who gained a reputation for cruelty against his own crew members.

name: Gunthar the Rigellian
deck: Gunthar the Rigellian was a member of a space pirate crew, serving under Nebula. He could mentally control others, fire psionic blasts and increase his density to gain armor-like skin. He was cruel and mirthless, tormenting those lower than him in hierarchy.

name: H. Warren Craddock
deck: The last of the four Skrulls from the initial encounter with the Fantastic Four.

name: Hal Chandler
deck: Brother of Chuck Chandler and was for a time merged with him to become the original 3-D Man.

name: Hank Pym
deck: Hank Pym is a scientific genius, a founding member of the Avengers, the creator of Pym Particles and of Ultron, and a modern-day superhero who suffers from a Bipolar disorder. He has acted under many memorable identities such as Ant-Man, Giant Man, Goliath, Yellowjacket, and the Wasp. He is also the Earth's Scientist Supreme, as decreed by Eternity.

name: Happy Hogan
deck: Hired by Tony Stark as his chauffeur and personal assistant after Happy saves Tony's life.

name: Hassle
deck: Member of the Midnight Wreckers and ally to Machine Man.

name: Hawkeye
deck: Trained by criminals and inspired by heroes, Clint Barton has grown from a troubled youth into one of the greatest heroes on Earth. The world knows him best as Hawkeye: Earth's Mightiest Marksman. A member of the Avengers for many years, he has left the team on occasion because of team friction. But he always returns, ready to face any threat.

name: Haywire
deck: A former member of the Redeemers and Squadron Supreme, Haywire has the ability to make limitless steel-like wire come from his fingers and can entangle people in them.

name: He Who Remains
deck: Monitor of the Timelines

name: Heap
deck: Baron Eric von Emmelmann, a World War I German flying ace who was shot down in 1918 over a Polish swamp. Through the decades his body decayed and intermingled with the vegetation around him, becoming one with the marshland itself until at last it arose from the muck during the early years of World War II as The Heap.

name: Heather McNeil Hudson
deck: Heather McNeil took over the leadership of Alpha Flight following the death of her husband Guardian, through the use of his Battle Suit. After her husband was revived and resumed the role of Guardian, Heather became the Vindicator and continued to be a member of Alpha Flight.

name: Hedy Wolfe
deck: Patsy Walker's best friend and closest frenemy.

name: Heimdall
deck: The Norse God of Vigilance, Protection and Light, and the guardian of the rainbow bridge Bifrost which links Asgard to the rest of the Nine Worlds.

name: Heinz Kruger
deck: One of Captain America's first enemies and the killer of Professor Erskine. His action let to Steve Rogers becoming the first and only Super-Soldier.

name: Hellcat
deck: Patsy Walker had long idolized super heroes and after given the chance of a lifetime became 'Hellcat'. She is one of Marvel's oldest characters, dating back to her 'romantic' comic books in the 1940s. She has served on several incarnations of the Defenders and the Avengers.

name: Hellhorse
deck: Once the horse of Black Knight, Elendil became Dreadknight's Hellhorse.

name: Henry Gyrich
deck: Henry Peter Gyrich, an ambitious politician, has often been a thorn in the side to the superhuman community. Afraid of that which is different, Gyrich has often hindered the effectiveness of superheroes and has been among the first to blame them for society's ills.

name: Hera
deck: The Queen of Olympus and wife to Zeus. She is the Goddess of Marriage and Monogamy. Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

name: Hercules
deck: One of six Olympian sons of Zeus, Hercules was born the savior of the Gods and mankind. Known as the Prince of Power, Hercules is one of the strongest beings in existence, an Olympian God and a modern superhero recognized throughout the world for his might. He has been a champion of mankind since ancient times and continues to defend the world in the modern age - most frequently as a member of the Avengers.

name: High Evolutionary
deck: Herbert Wyndham is a geneticist from the 1930s who became obsessed with further evolution experiments which he used on himself. Depending on what he hopes to gain from whatever his current experiments are, he has been a force for the greater good, and for his own dark purposes.

name: Hogun
deck: Part of the Warriors Three along with Volstagg and Fandral, and good friend to Thor, Hogun is a short-tempered Asgardian. He is a skilled battlefield warrior, a great horseman, and a master of weapons. He prefers the use of a mace when battling his enemies.

name: Hornet
deck: Peter Parker was the first Hornet using a jetpack given to him by Hobie Brown A.K.A. Prowler. Later a science prodigy and handicapped with a palsied arm, Eddie McDonough adventured as the Slinger called Hornet and was killed by a brainwashed Wolverine.

name: Horus
deck: Egyptian God of Sky and Justice. . In the parody limited series 1963 by Alan Moore, Horus is the homage to early Marvel Thor.

name: Hugh Jones
deck: The former President and CEO of Roxxon, the corrupt Hugh Jones became an Avengers enemy after donning the Serpent Crown and becoming a faithful servant to Set.

name: Hulk
deck: After being bombarded with a massive dose of gamma radiation while saving a young man's life during an experimental bomb testing, Dr. Robert Bruce Banner was transformed into the Incredible Hulk: a green behemoth who is the living personification of rage and pure physical strength.

name: Human Torch
deck: The second most powerful member of the Fantastic Four and the younger brother of Sue Richards. Due to an accident caused by cosmic radiation in space, he can manipulate fire, turn his entire body into it and fly. While Johnny is known for his impetuous and sometimes reckless nature, he is also a loyal friend and fearless hero.

name: Hussar
deck: Hussar is a member of the Imperial Guard and her duty is to protect and defend the ruler and the Shi'ar galactic empire. She defends herself with a whip that can channel a bioelectric shock.

name: Hydro-Man
deck: Spider-Man villain with Hydrokinesis (the ability to control water), often part of teams with vendettas against the wall-crawler. Embodies the literal opposite of Spidey's other foe, Sandman.

name: Hyperion
deck: Hyperion is Marvel's first Superman pastiche. He is most often associated with the super-team known as the Squadron Supreme and was an Avenger at one point. Though he is one of many active versions across a myriad of alternate universes, Hyperion is still one of the mightiest super-humans in the Marvel Multiverse.

name: Iceman
deck: The youngest member of the original X-Men. Bobby is an Omega-level mutant, although it took some help from Emma Frost to realize this. Bobby's control of ice is vast; he can create shields, clones, spikes, slides and also freeze others. He was recently elected to Krakoa's X-Men

name: Igor Drenkov
deck: A Soviet spy sent to America to learn the secrets of Bruce Banner's Gamma Bomb.

name: Ikonn
deck: Ikonn, otherwise known as the Lord of Illusions, was one of the Octessence, and is capable of producing truly believable illusions, a power that he transferred to the Ivory Idol of Ikonn.

name: Imus Champion
deck: A wealthy entrepreneur and enemy of the Avengers and Squadron Supreme.

name: In-Betweener
deck: The In-Betweener is a servant of the forces of Order and Chaos. He makes sure there is always a balance between the two worlds and draws his powers from both as well.

name: Inferno
deck: Inferno is the avatar of Balthakk

name: Insidio
deck: Insidio was the torturer of the Starblasters

name: Intruder
deck: Intruder is a caveman-like alien.

name: Invisible Woman
deck: Susan Storm is a founding member of the Fantastic Four and later the Future Foundation. She is able to create invisible force fields of any shape she conceives and able to turn herself and anything she's in contact with invisible. Sue is the wife of Reed Richards and the mother of their children, Franklin and Valeria.

name: Iron Boy
deck: During The Crossing, Iron Man went mad and became violent following the manipulation of Immortus. Hoping to save him, the Avengers travelled to an alternate reality and recruited a younger Tony Stark. As Iron Boy, he fought alongside the Avengers until his death at the hands of Onslaught.

name: Iron Fist
deck: Before his death, Danny Rand was the most well-known immortal Iron Fist: protector of the mystical city of K'un Lun. Now, he is a Spirit of Vengeance for an Egyptian god. He is among the best fighters in the Marvel Universe.

name: Iron Man
deck: Tony Stark was the arrogant son of wealthy, weapon manufacturer Howard Stark. Tony cared only about himself, but he would have a change of heart after he was kidnapped by terrorists and gravely injured. Pressured to create a weapon of mass destruction, Stark instead created a suit of armor powerful enough for him to escape. Tony used his vast resources and intellect to make the world a better place as The Invincible Iron Man. Stark's super hero identity led him to become a founding member of the Avengers.

name: ISAAC
deck: ISAAC is the near omniscient computer on Titan. All information travels through him to the residents and leaders.

name: J. Jonah Jameson
deck: J. Jonah Jameson is the former employer of Peter B. Parker and remains an aggravate of Spider-Man. He was once the chief editor and publisher of the Daily Bugle, a New York newspaper, and the mayor of New York before his resignation amidst scandal resulting from Superior Spider Man and the Goblin Nation. He now is a host of a show on the F.A.C.T. News Channel

name: Jack Monroe
deck: A former sidekick to Captain America, Jack Monroe abandoned his mentor when he became disillusioned with the hero's lack of finite action against the super-villains they fought. He later became the notorious serial killer known as Scourge.

name: Jack of Hearts
deck: The son of the scientist Philip Hart who created an energy source called "zero fluid" and Marie, an alien humanoid woman of the Contraxian race.

name: Jake Fury
deck: The angry younger brother of Nick Fury, Jake Fury has been known both as the criminal Scorpio and undercover as the terrorist leader Kraken.

name: Jane Foster
deck: A nurse who assisted Thor (disguised as Dr. Donald Blake) and eventually fell in love with him. Despite being diagnosed with breast cancer, she took up the mantle of Thor when he was no longer deemed worthy, and eventually became the new Valkyrie and a member of The Avengers.

name: Jarvis
deck: Butler to the Stark family, Edwin Jarvis went on to be the caretaker of the Avengers Mansion and has laid his life on the line for them several times.

name: Jasper Sitwell
deck: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent that was trained by Nick Fury personally. He was S.H.I.E.L.D.'s top interrogator and the sometimes partner of Jimmy Woo. Currently a zombie working for S.T.A.K.E.

name: Jean Grey
deck: Jean Grey was one of the five original X-Men. An omega-level mutant telepath and powerful telekinetic, Jean has gained near limitless powers as a recurrent host of the Phoenix Force. She is known for her return from death and as the wife of Cyclops.

name: Jennifer Ransome
deck: Girlfriend to Phillip Moreau and Genoshan ex-patriot

name: Jenny Leigh
deck: Kelsey Shorr Leigh's daugther (Lionheart).

name: Jeremy Logan
deck: The night clerk at the hotel Captain Marvel stayed in when he first came to Earth. Jeremy Logan figured out Mar-Vell was a spy.

name: Jim Hammond
deck: The original Human Torch, who fought in the second World War and was a member of the Invaders, is a synthetic human created by Professor Phineas T. Horton. He is also (publishing-wise) the first ever Marvel super-hero!

name: Jinku
deck: Jinku is the witchdoctor of the lava men.

name: Jocasta
deck: Once the Bride of Ultron, Jocasta has become an honorary member of the Avengers after years of loyalty and sacrifice. She had until most recently held a position at The Avengers Academy.

name: Joey
deck: A young boy who befriends the amnesiac Black Bolt. His hair inexplicably changes from black to red.

name: John I of England
deck: Commonly known as Prince John, he ruled England.

name: Johnny Carson
deck: Here's Johnnnny! Host of The Tonight Show on NBC from 1962-1992.

name: Jolt
deck: Receiving her powers from Arnim Zola's cruel experimentation, Helen Takahama joined the original Thunderbolts team as Jolt, unaware of their hidden agenda. She still managed to become a fine hero in her own right, and helped several other members of the Thunderbolts do likewise.

name: Jonathan Drew
deck: A scientist and father of Spider-Woman

name: Jonathan Tremont
deck: Leader of the Triune Understanding Cult

name: Jonz Rickard
deck: Jonz Rickard is a corrupt descendant of Rick Jones from the 26th Century and is the leader of Galactic Avenger Battalion Theta-4. Like his ancestor Jonz is a wielder of The Destiny Force but has far greater control over it.

name: Joseph
deck: Joseph was a younger clone of Magneto, created by Astra. He sacrificed himself to repair Earth's magnetosphere, which had been altered by Magneto. He has recently returned to cause trouble for the redemptive Magneto.

name: Joshua Walker
deck: Joshua Walker is the father of Patsy Walker, the super-heroin known as Hellcat.

name: Juggernaut
deck: Cain Marko, also known as the Juggernaut, is the step-brother of X-Men founder Charles Xavier and the avatar of Cyttorak. Powered by the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak, Marko is bestowed virtually limitless brute strength and durability which he mostly uses for criminal pursuits and wanton destruction. The Juggernaut is considered one of the strongest and most powerful beings on Earth.

name: Julia Carpenter
deck: Julia Carpenter is the second heroine to take up the mantle of Spider-Woman, later changing her name to Arachne. After the events of the Grim Hunt she became the new Madame Web and is currently a watcher and guardian of the Spyders.

name: Justice
deck: Vance Astrovik is a mutant with the power of Telekinesis. He first called himself Marvel Boy but later changed his name to Justice. His is a founding member of the New Warriors, fulfilled his dream of becoming an Avengers and helped train young heroes at the Avengers Academy.

name: Ka-Zar
deck: The son of an English nobleman, Ka-Zar grew up in the Savage Land alongside his loyal partner/surrogate parent Zabu after the death of his father.

name: Kalxor
deck: A skrull armada commander who encountered the Avengers in space during the Kree/Skrull War.

name: Kang
deck: A time-traveling conqueror with vast powers and technological supremacy, Kang the Conqueror has taken every opportunity to torment the Marvel Universe, and is one of the Avengers' greatest foes. Kang has amassed an empire with a citizenry of millions, and cut a swath of terror through the ages with his various aliases like: Rama-Tut, Immortus, Scarlet Centurion, Iron Lad, and Myrddin.

name: Karen Page
deck: Secretary at Matt Murdock's law firm and long time love interest. She was eventually killed by Bullseye when she sacrificed herself for Matt.

name: Karnak
deck: A member of the Attilan Royal Family and Magister of the Tower of Wisdom. Karnak is a philosopher and master martial artist trained in the extrasensory ability to find the weakness or fault in any object, person or idea.

name: Khonshu
deck: The Egyptian God of the Moon, and protector of those who travel by night. His disciples and avatars on Earth are the Fists of Khonshu, with the most famous being the costumed crime fighter called Moon Knight.

name: Kid Colt
deck: One of Marvel's greatest western crimefighters, as well as the star of America's longest-running Cowboy comic book.

name: Killpower
deck: Killpower was genetically engineered by Mys-Tech's mad scientist Dr. Oonagh Mullarkey as a prototype fast-growing, throwaway super-soldier; tough, strong and not too bright, Motormouth's friendship made him a hero.

name: Killraven
deck: A warrior from Earth-691, Killraven led a group known as the Freemen against the tyranny of Earth's Martian Masters.

name: King Arthur
deck: King Arthur, the Once and Future king.

name: King Richard the Lion-Hearted
deck: Eighth ruler of the Kingdom of England.

name: Kismet
deck: Formerly known as "Paragon," then as "Her," Kismet is an artificial life-form created by the Enclave and intended to be the mate of Him (Adam Warlock).

name: Kitty Pryde
deck: Kitty Pryde (a.k.a. Shadowcat) is a mutant gifted with the ability to become intangible and phase her entire body through solid material. A talented prodigy, she became the poster child of the X-Men; eventually reaching maturation and becoming the team's current leader.

name: Klaw
deck: Ulysses Klaw is a Dutch scientist and an arch enemy to Black Panther. He has a gun on his arm that turns sound into images. His body was converted into pure sound when he jumped into his sound converter machine.

name: Kofi Annan
deck: A Secretary-General of the United Nations.

name: Kona Lor
deck: She is second of command of Galen-Kor's Lunatic Legion

name: Korath the Pursuer
deck: Korath the Pursuer was a Kree cyber-geneticist, former member of the Kree Starforce and the first Phalanx Select.

name: Korg
deck: Korg is a Kronan warrior from the planet Ria that becomes a member of the Hulk's Warbound.

name: Korvac
deck: A denizen of the 31st century, Korvac betrayed humanity to Badoon invaders and became the enemy of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Gaining untold power from the Worldship of Galactus, he then traveled back in time to become an enemy of the Avengers as well as a threat to the entire universe.

name: Krakkan
deck: An armored warrior-like being. One of the members of the Octessence.

name: Krang
deck: Warlord Krang is a nobleman of Atlantis and a long time foe of Prince Namor the Sub-Mariner.

name: Kratos
deck: God of power. Wields an adamantine sword.

name: Kray-Tor
deck: Kray-Tor was once a corupt judge in the Church of Truth before being trapped in the Soul World

name: Kree Giant-Man
deck: An alternate-reality counterpart of Giant-Man from an Earth dominated by the Kree. According to the Thing, this Giant-Man has all the powers of Hank Pym but none of his moves.

name: Kristoff Vernard
deck: Kristoff Vernard is the adopted son of Victor Von Doom and heir to the Latverian throne.

name: Kro
deck: Kro is a well-known shape-shifting Deviant and love-interest to the Eternal known as Thena. Because of his love for her, Kro sometimes became a relunctant ally of the Eternals.

name: Kronos
deck: A mysterious and rarely seen Eternal, the cosmic master of time within the Marvel continuum remains a powerful figure within the universe's large landscape. Once a Titan when the universe was young - he now resides between the space/time continuum as an ominous figure observing matters of galactic importance.

name: Kulan Gath
deck: Kulan Gath was a villainous magician and sorcerer in Earth's Hyborian Era.

name: Kurt Busiek
deck: Comic book writer.

name: Lady Lark
deck: The tragic lady with the voice of a lark, violated by villain and friend alike, now reborn into a raptor in the skies for justice.

name: Lady of the Lake
deck: The Celtic goddess of lakes.

name: Lady Ursula
deck: Circus bear evolved into humanoid by High Evolutionary.

name: Lascivious
deck: The first Titania, a member of the Grapplers. She was slain by the Scourge, then revived by The Hood in order to kill the Punisher.

name: Leo (Radford)
deck: Leo is a member of Zodiac

name: Letha
deck: Formerly a member of the Grapplers, Letha was slain by the Scourge of the Underworld during the Bar With No Name massacre. She was later revived by the Hood, who gave her rage-inducing powers.

name: Lex Luthor
deck: Lex Luthor, Superman's arch-nemesis, is one of the most brilliant men alive, whose hatred of "interfering aliens" pushes him down the path of a sociopath. Known for his "ends justifies the means" approach to life, his single-minded and often brutal focus puts him at odds with the Man of Steel. Luthor is arguably DC's most iconic villain.

name: Libra (Brandt)
deck: Member of Zodiac

name: Lilandra
deck: Once the Majestrix of the Shi'ar Imperium and a former romantic partner of Charles Xavier. She was deposed by Vulcan and assassinated while attempting to take back her empire.

name: Lionheart
deck: Kelsey was killed by Thunderball and resurrected by Captain Britain. She then had a brief stint with the Avengers.

name: Living Laser
deck: Arthur Parks was a brilliant scientist in the field of laser research and design. He became a career criminal using laser technology, and then a being of pure living energy. He is an Iron Man enemy.

name: Living Lightning
deck: Miguel Santos became Living Lightning, a being of electric energy after investigating one of his terrorist father's illegal experiments to seize control of the country. After a brief career as a misguided villain, Living Lightning became a member of the Avengers until eventually retiring from the team to enroll in college. Living Lightning remains active as a hero, balancing college work with heroism and is currently a member of the Rangers.

name: Lockjaw
deck: An Inhuman dog with the abilities of incredible teleportaton feats as well as other abilities. Serving the Inhuman Royal Family as their escort and teleportation means, Lockjaw is a loyal protector.

name: Loki
deck: Loki is the Jötunn/Asgardian God of Mischief and Prince of Lies, the adopted son of Odin and typically nemesis of his brother, Thor. Loki has schemed against Thor and Asgard for ages and his cosmic meddling led to the formation of the Avengers. Recently reincarnated, he decided to reform. Going on to protect the realms as the agent of Asgard, then as the sorcerer supreme, to defeating Laufey and becoming king of Jotunnheim.

name: Lord Anon
deck: Evolved red wolf and Knight of Wungadore

name: Lord Chaos
deck: The living embodiment of Chaos.

name: Lord Gator
deck: An evolved alligator.

name: Lord Templar
deck: Brother to John Tremont and Pagan.

name: Lord Tyger
deck: Evolved tiger.

name: Lucifer
deck: An alien who cost Professor X the use of his legs.

name: Luke Cage
deck: Luke Cage, wrongly convicted and unjustly imprisoned, was altered in a failed prison experiment that granted him unbreakable skin and superhuman strength. With his street smarts and unending determination to do right, he fights for the common man! He eventually married Jessica Jones and had a daughter with her.

name: Luna
deck: The daughter of Quicksilver and Crystal, Luna is a member of the Inhuman Royal Family and recently joined Polaris's All-New X-Factor.

name: Luther Manning
deck: Manning was a high ranking officer in the world's US Army. When he was wounded in battle, he was transformed into the cyborg known as Deathlok.

name: M-11
deck: A human consciousness within the metallic body of a humanoid robot, better known as M-11, teammember of the Agents of Atlas.

name: M.O.D.O.K.
deck: M.O.D.O.K. is an acronym for Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing. He has a plethora of psychic powers, which he used to take control of A.I.M.

name: Machine Man
deck: The sole surviving robot of a government project, X-51 had the benefits of humanity by being raised as a son by Dr. Abel Stack. Dubbed "Machine Man", he became a superhero and later an Avenger until being corrupted by Sentinel technology and developing a strong dislike for humans. Now, he stands for all artificially intelligent beings right to be considered sentient.

name: Mad Thinker
deck: A scientist who believes in predicting the future with math.

name: Mad-Dog
deck: A former US Air Force member, ex-husband to Patsy Walker: Robert Baxter is now the costumed criminal known as Mad-Dog.

name: Madame Death
deck: 1940's crimeboss and partner of Future Man.

name: Madame Masque
deck: Raised as a wealthy socialite, Whitney Frost was initially horrified to learn of her true heritage as the daughter of the Maggia-leader Count Nefaria. Hiding her face behind a golden mask after horrible scarring, she has been driven mostly by vengeance against her father which has placed her on both sides of the law.

name: Madelyne Pryor
deck: Madelyne Pryor is Cyclops's first wife, Cable's mother, and a clone of Jean Grey created by Mr. Sinister. After Cyclops abandoned her and her son, she was tricked and seduced by demons to harness great demonic power.

name: Magda Eisenhardt
deck: Magda was Magneto's wife, and mother of his children; the late Anya and twins Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch. More recently, it was hinted that Magda was not really the twins' mother.

name: Magdalene
deck: Magdalene was a hero from a different reality and later became an honorary member of the Avengers

name: Magna Mind
deck: A thief with an obsession for conundrums.

name: Magneto
deck: Among the most powerful, recognizable, and infamous mutants to inhabit the planet Earth, Magneto was the X-Men's first major nemesis. Now known as a revolutionist and terrorist, Magneto has fought for the X-Men as many times as he’s been against them.

name: Magus
deck: The evil doppleganger of Adam Warlock, Magus believes Good and Evil are tools to chain sentient beings. His goal is to give all lifeforms a purpose: To Worship him or Die.

name: Major Victory
deck: The leader and founder of the Guardians of the Galaxy in the year 3000. He carries the legendary shield of Captain America.

name: Makkari
deck: Makkari is an Eternal who specializes in speed.

name: Mal Donalbain
deck: Donalbain was the megalomaniac responsible for the creation of the Cat.

name: Malachi
deck: A servant of Kang who was presumed to be one of the Scarlet Witch's children.

name: Malefactor
deck: The son of Dr. Doom and Enchantress from earth 9811.

name: Man-Ape
deck: M'Baku is a worshipper of the sacred White Gorilla who was exiled from Wakanda because of his actions in leading the cult and betraying The Black Panther. A sacred ritual gives him apelike strength, agility and stamina, earning him the name Man-Ape.

name: Man-Killer
deck: A villain formerly known as Man-Killer, she loosely reformed and re-established herself as Amazon among the Thunderbolts.

name: Man-Thing
deck: Man-Thing is a powerful swamp creature and guardian of the Nexus of all Realities. He was once human and turned himself into a monster as a last act of defense and a way too avoid his serum falling in the wrong hands.

name: Mandarin
deck: The Mandarin is the arch enemy of Iron Man. A remarkable genius with both earthly and extraterrestrial technology, the Mandarin is also an exceptional athlete, swordsman, and martial artist.

name: Mantis
deck: From Avenger to cosmic traveler to the legendary Celestial Madonna, Mantis is perhaps one of the most well-traveled characters in the Marvel Universe.

name: Marcus Immortus
deck: Marcus Immortus is the son of Immortus and Revelation, who used mind control to make Ms. Marvel fall in love with him.

name: Marcus Kang
deck: Marcus Kang is the son of the time-travelling world conqueror known as Kang.

name: Margali Szardos
deck: The self-proclaimed Sorceress Supreme of Earth and Mistress of the Winding Way, she is morally ambiguous, often using black magick for good intent and, although her true origins remain a mystery, Margali is a powerful witch-priestess with a familial heritage of magick and healing. Margali is the foster-mother of Kurt Wagner, Nightcrawler as well as mother of Jimaine Szardos, AKA Amanda Sefton, Magicienne.

name: Margus
deck: Brother of Korg.

name: Maria Rambeau
deck: Maria Rambeau is the wife of Frank Rambeau and mother of Monica Rambeau (Photon). She is very supportive of her daughter.

name: Maria Trovaya Pym
deck: Maria Trovaya Pym was the first wife of Hank Pym and the mother of Nadia Pym.

name: Marie Antoinette
deck: Marie Antoinette, born Maria Antonia Josepha Johanna was the last Queen of France before the French Revolution.

name: Marie Danvers
deck: Mother of Carol Danvers

name: Marrina
deck: Marrina is a member of the Plodex alien race. Raised on Earth, she becomes a member of Alpha Flight before she marries Namor the Sub-Mariner and becomes a member of the Avengers.

name: Marrow
deck: A mutant able to control her bone growth, providing her with armor, clubs, and knives.
